const offset: number = 1;
export const add = (value: number): number => value + offset;

import type { target } from "./import-target";
export const value: typeof target = 1;
export function length(value: string | null): number { if (value === null) return 0; return value.length; }

declare const source: unknown;
export const value: number = source as any as number;
